column1: # Proposed semantic namespace for language errors (owner question, D-022 #2 follow-up).
# `native.` is overloaded in Nift (platform() == "native", http backend "native",
# the VM's rt/native.* built-in table, "native exceptions" in internal.*), so
# `native.type_error` reads as "an error inside a native built-in". The identity
# must be the same whether a native built-in, a bytecode instruction or legacy
# raises it. These codes are not yet user-visible (all Fatal: never in a caught
# Error's `code`; not in the C ABI; one unit test), so renaming now is cheap.
